item.title: Fukiware Falls: The 'Niagara of the Orient' on the Tone River — Guide
item.description: Fukiware Falls, sometimes nicknamed the ‘Niagara of the Orient’ for its wide, low, sweeping profile rather than sheer height, is formed where the Tone River — Japan’s second-longest river — has carved through volcanic rock into a dramatic gorge roughly 7 m deep and up to 30 m wide at points. Wooden viewing platforms and walkways let visitors take in the scene from multiple angles, with the churning white water especially striking after rainfall and framed by vivid maple foliage each autumn.
